blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلوةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ق رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: My Rabb, make me and those among my offspring establishers of Salah! Our Rabb! Accept (this) prayer of mine!

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَقِمِ الصَّلوةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَي غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ ؕ إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) establish Salah from the declining of the sun (from its zenith) until the darkness of the night (that is, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha and so on) and also the Fajr Salah! Indeed, the Fajr Salah is attended (by the angels).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَي صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And they are those who are mindful of their Salahs.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نُودِيَ للِصَّلوةِ مِنْ يَّوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاسْعَوْا إِلَي ذِكْرِ اللهِ وَذَرُوا الْبَيْعَ ؕ ذلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O you who believe, when (you) are called to Salah on Friday, hasten to the remembrance of Allah, and leave off trading (at that time) — this is best for you, if you only knew (its benefit).
